_header: BUT-694 (option c): shared test vectors for the Swedish street-address +
person-name PII heuristics. SOURCE OF TRUTH lives here, next to the TS
The Dart mirror (lib/services/llm/pii_scrubber.dart) COPIES this file to
test/unit/services/llm/fixtures/ and runs the same vectors — that copy is
the cross-port sync mechanism. If you change a vector here, re-copy the
file to the Dart side and vice versa.
Each vector: scrubPii(input) must equal `expected` EXACTLY (full-string
equality, not substring checks). Vectors are heuristics-only: inputs
contain no emails/phones/personnummer so both ports can run them through
the full scrubber without interference from the older rules.

vectors.name: RULE A: gatan + house number is redacted
vectors.input: Hämta nyckeln på Storgatan 14 i Stockholm

vectors.name: RULE A: vägen + number with attached letter (52B)
RULE A: torget
RULE A: gränd
RULE A: gränden (definite form)
RULE A: allén
RULE A: stigen, lowercase street word + lowercase house letter
RULE A: backen
RULE A: platsen
RULE A negative: street name WITHOUT house number stays
RULE A negative: street word + duration is NOT an address (unit lookahead)
RULE A negative: bare common noun 'vägen' never matches (prefix required)
RULE A negative: cooking range untouched
RULE A negative: realistic instruction text passes unredacted

vectors.expected: Skala potatisen och skär i tunna skivor. Varva med lök och ansjovis i en smord form.
